messages:
sam: FYI deploying route-v2 in 8m. using quantile ramp with region phases.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy by @sam at 2026-04-02 02:13 UTC. runbook: /runbooks/route-v2-quantile (link).

iris: proposed: canary q0-5 (2m smoke), q0-25 (10m), q0-60 (20m), then open. region order: us-west -> us-east -> eu.

sre-oncall: safety gates: p99 delta > +200ms for 5m OR error-rate +0.5% -> fast-disable. queue depth >1500 -> fallback. pager to #eng-oncall.

pav: pin binary: `rbctl ff set route_v2.version "v2.5.0" --sticky`. disable CLI: `rbctl ff set route_v2.enabled false --note "safety"`.

ops-bot: /ops ff off route_v2 --reason "safety" will also attach runbook.

sam: decision: proceed. i'll post release note 2m before start. i'll be monitoring first 30m.

deply-bot: Deploy started by @sam at 1758009999

deploy-bot: Canary enabled -> routing quantile 0-5 in us-west (~0.5% traffic)

iris: canary p50/p95 stable, p99 +30ms. moving to q0-25 after 3m.

sre-oncall: no alerts. keep watch on CPU and queue length.

pav: promoted to q0-25. pinned version confirmed.

ops-bot: reaction :rocket: :thumbsup:

sam: all phases green, opening to 100%. release note: "route-v2 live with quantile ramp, pinned v2.5.0, safety gates enabled."

iris: nice work. closing thread."
